promotion_conditions: Every frozen primary and guardrail metric meets its target over the exact frozen universe with complete denominator reconciliation.
Every mandatory gate passes with no FAIL/BLOCKED gate at promotion.
The independent evaluator actor differs from the implementation actor and independently recomputes promotion-authoritative evidence.
Frozen registry hashes, all v0.10 parent hashes, all failed-v0.11 baseline hashes, selector ownership closure, and the final clean-extracted package manifest validate exactly.
Promotion may not exceed PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL.

requirements.description: Machine-readable package-only lifecycle checkpoint exposes exact state, immutable boundary, blockers, validation profile, next legal action, required artifacts, and stop condition.
Next legal action is deterministically derived from state plus blocker transition tokens using frozen lifecycle transition rules, with no answer-key or hidden-chat dependence.
Every explicit dependency has exactly one permitted machine-derived provenance and mechanically derived conflict serialization is included in the effective DAG.
All maximum-work critical paths and deterministic dependency/conflict-safe execution waves are computed exactly.
Maximum useful parallelism preserves the fixed 23-source-task integration denominator and requires context, cache, retry, integration, and verification contracts for every emitted workstream.
Failure reruns only the failed workstream and declared dependents; unrelated successful work is preserved unless explicitly invalidated.
Speculative/preparatory work remains non-authoritative until prerequisites resolve.
Validation profiles and immutable-boundary mechanics are explicit and mechanically checkable with zero unclassified, overlap, multimatch, or stale ownership errors.
Every preregistered future output path classifies exactly once as retry successor before freeze and at later lifecycle checkpoints.
Exact 155 parent nodes, 25 active regressions including REG-0025, 1120 v0.10 hashes, and 154 failed-v0.11 baseline hashes remain mandatory fail-closed guardrails.
All 16 frozen promotion-authoritative metrics preserve reviewed universes/targets; empirical efficiency metrics remain shadow-only and cannot authorize a general speed claim.
